operation.security: projectApiKey HTTP Bearer: whole live key of the route's project with auth:tokens:mint and no database restriction; key and project IP allowlists apply; not organization key/JWT/cookie
operation.request: {user_id: canonical uppercase ULID, database?: canonical ULID|null, claims?: object|null}; no unknown members
operation.claims: at most 32 members and 1000 bytes serialized; names [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}; values strings <=256 characters, finite numbers, booleans, or arrays of <=64 strings or <=64 numbers
operation.success: 200 application/json {access_token:string compact JWT, token_type:Bearer, expires_in:300}; no refresh/lifetime request parameter

errors.400: nested error invalid_request; malformed/unknown/oversized request or claims
errors.401: nested error unauthorized; missing/revoked/expired key; WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="ts-auth"
errors.404: nested error not_found; key of another project, database-restricted key, or closed project
errors.429: OAuth flat error rate_limited; Retry-After seconds; shared token IP budget plus 1000/minute per key

operation.retry: none; every mint sent once even if Retry-After is present
operation.revocation: key revocation stops future issuance; offline JWTs survive until expiry plus validation clock skew
operation.token: typ at+jwt, ES256, signed by the project tenant key ring; iss {auth origin}/{project}; aud the project's TerraBase data audiences only; sub=user_id; token_use=custom; database and claims when given; exp 300 seconds; no account provisioning
